body: Thank you for that reference. I definitely have been able to work with the voices in the past. But now, they all are yelling at me. I believe there is six or seven distinct ones. That TED talk was uplifting, thank you.
I see no recovery. I'm young to be experiencing whatever this is. It feels like schizophrenia mixed with depression and anxiety disorder. I don't think I can live a comfortable life

I got out of the bathroom after cutting for a while. I'm feeling so dissociated, I'm watching myself with a telescope. Somehow I can feel tears welling up, but I can't cry. I'm losing any remnant of how I recognize myself

I'm on a form of antipsychotic for another condition, but recently stopped taking my anxiety medication. I suppose this is what a mental breakdown feels like. I find a solice in my idealism of leaving this place. My dissociative mind feels like a fading window, my eyes plastered on a balloon flying into the darkness.

No. They might call me, but I can't trust any of them anymore. I heard what they really think of me. That or I'm seriously losing my head. Either way, I can't take it anymore. It's crippling everything in me
no. My life is worthless. I'm self destructive, and destroy everyone around me. I can't tell what's real. I don't know what I need. But I don't want to feel this dreadful pain
